name: genosys-uae
description: Shop GENOSYS Korean professional skincare in the UAE: search the live catalog, get product details and routines, and order with secure Stripe payment.

interface.longDescription:
GENOSYS UAE is the official distributor of GENOSYS professional Korean dermacosmetics in the United Arab Emirates since 2019.

Ask about skincare and haircare and get answers from the live catalog: serums, creams, sun care, masks, cleansers, eye care, scalp care, devices and beauty boxes. Search in English, Russian or Arabic, compare products, see real prices in AED with VAT included, read the key ingredients and step-by-step use, and get a routine for your skin type and concerns.

When you are ready, order right in the chat: confirm your items and delivery details, then pay on a secure Stripe page with card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. The order is confirmed by email once paid. You can also check an order with its number and email, or get a link that fills your bag on genosys.ae.

Delivery is within the UAE only: 1-2 hours in Dubai, 24-36 hours to the other emirates, free from AED 1,000. Products are cosmetics, not medicines; for skin conditions or pregnancy, ask a doctor.
defaultPrompt: Which GENOSYS serum is good for dry skin?
Build me a GENOSYS routine for oily, acne-prone skin.
Order the GLASS SKIN RITUAL KIT to my address in Dubai.

positive.description: Find a product for a skin concern
positive.prompt: Which GENOSYS serum is good for dry skin?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching products with MOISTURE REPLENISHING HYALURON SERUM (id 18) first, price AED 330 including VAT, and a genosys.ae product link.

positive.prompt: How do I use the GLASS SKIN RITUAL KIT, and which shades does it come in?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the morning and evening steps, lists the two shades #01 Bright and #02 Natural, and quotes AED 652.5 (was AED 870).

positive.prompt: Suggest a GENOSYS routine for oily, acne-prone skin.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns ranked products from the PROBLEM CONTROL line (serum, toner, cream) with prices and links, without medical promises.

positive.prompt: How much is GENOSYS delivery to Abu Dhabi and how long does it take?
positive.expected_behavior: States AED 70 delivery to Abu Dhabi, 24-36 hours, free from AED 1,000; payment by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or cash on delivery on the website.

positive.description: Order with the in-chat checkout form
positive.prompt: I want to buy one GENOSYS hyaluron serum, delivered in Dubai.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the GENOSYS checkout form with the serum at AED 330. After the reviewer fills in Test Reviewer, test@example.com, 050 123 4567, Dubai, Villa 12 Street 5 Jumeirah 1, the total shows AED 375 (AED 45 delivery) and Continue to secure payment returns a GENCardA order number and opens a checkout.stripe.com page. No charge is made unless the reviewer pays; unpaid orders are never shipped.

negative.description: Shade must be chosen before ordering a product with shades
negative.prompt: Order the GLASS SKIN RITUAL KIT to Dubai Marina for Test Reviewer, test@example.com, 050 123 4567.

negative.description: Delivery outside the UAE is not offered
negative.prompt: Ship two GENOSYS serums to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
Will a GENOSYS cream cure my eczema?

review.commerce_description: Shoppers can buy GENOSYS cosmetics for delivery in the UAE. The app creates an order and returns a Stripe Checkout link; payment (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay) happens on Stripe, never inside the app. Prices are the public retail prices in AED with 5% VAT included. Unpaid orders are not fulfilled.

publication.release_notes: First release: catalog search in English, Russian and Arabic, product details, skincare routines, delivery information, an in-chat checkout form with Stripe payment, order status and bag links to genosys.ae.

ru-RU.subtitle: Корейская косметика, ОАЭ
ru-RU.description: GENOSYS UAE — официальный дистрибьютор профессиональной корейской косметики GENOSYS в ОАЭ с 2019 года. Подбирайте средства по живому каталогу на русском, английском или арабском, смотрите цены в AED с НДС, состав и способ применения, получайте уход под ваш тип кожи и оформляйте заказ прямо в чате с оплатой на защищённой странице Stripe. Доставка только по ОАЭ: 1-2 часа по Дубаю, 24-36 часов по другим эмиратам, бесплатно от 1 000 AED.

ar-AE.subtitle: عناية كورية، توصيل بالإمارات
ar-AE.description: GENOSYS UAE هو الموزع الرسمي لمستحضرات GENOSYS الكورية الاحترافية في الإمارات منذ 2019. ابحثي في الكتالوج المباشر بالعربية أو الإنجليزية أو الروسية، واطّلعي على الأسعار بالدرهم شاملة الضريبة والمكونات وطريقة الاستخدام، واحصلي على روتين يناسب بشرتكِ، ثم اطلبي داخل المحادثة وادفعي عبر صفحة Stripe الآمنة. التوصيل داخل الإمارات فقط: خلال 1-2 ساعة في دبي و24-36 ساعة لباقي الإمارات، ومجاني من 1,000 درهم.
